summary: Implemented the dedicated simplifier, its Git-only run/skip route, fixed handoff, configuration, activation checks, status, agent guidance, and documentation. All 22 acceptance criteria passed.

acceptanceCriteria.probe: npm run check: completeVerifierPass.integration.test.ts and run-simplifier.integration.test.ts complete verification in temporary projects without Git repositories and assert simplifier-running.
npm run check: resolve-findings.integration.test.ts rejects the sole V1/F1 outside Git with reason Outside approved scope and asserts saved simplifier-running and preserved rejection.
npm run check: run-simplifier.integration.test.ts covers unavailable Git execution, failed Git, false output, and a real non-repository; each returns the exact skip warning.
npm run check: all four Git skip scenarios assert saved candidate-ready without an execution error.

npm run check: run-simplifier.integration.test.ts initializes a real Git repository, captures one scripted foreground delegation request, and checks agent, spec, canonical cwd, fresh context, model, thinking, and 60-minute timeout.

npm run check: record-simplifier-handoff.integration.test.ts submits src/counts.ts and src/report.ts with the agreed summary and caller note; saved handoffs/simplifier/S.json equals exactly the submitted fields plus version.
npm run check: the successful scripted simplifier run records No simplification needed with empty refactoredFiles and notes, then asserts candidate-ready.

npm run check: record-simplifier-handoff.integration.test.ts independently rejects an escaping path, extra findings field, mismatched saved identity, different submitted spec, and verifier-running phase; workflow bytes remain unchanged and no S.json appears.
npm run check: run-simplifier.integration.test.ts returns completed without saving a handoff and asserts a protocol error, unchanged simplifier-running, and absent S.json.
npm run check: run-simplifier.integration.test.ts scripts failed, timed_out, and interrupted responses before handoff; each reports a delegation error without advancing or saving a result.
npm run check: loadConfiguration.unit.test.ts loads version-only configuration and asserts simplifier defaults openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol, high, and 60 minutes.
npm run check: loadConfiguration.unit.test.ts loads only simplifier.timeoutMinutes: 90 and checks unchanged simplifier model/thinking and builder/verifier defaults.
npm run check: loadConfiguration.unit.test.ts loads simplifier.timeoutMinutes: 0 and asserts Invalid timeout at simplifier.timeoutMinutes.
Inspected agents/verifier.md and executed Python assertions confirming removal of Review code quality and its instruction-violation procedure while retaining acceptance verification.

Executed Python comparison of the five retained guidance sections against .agents/skills/simplifier/SKILL.md, allowing only the agreed check-baseline adaptation and coordinated result.a.count to result.get("a") clarification; examples and tables match.

Inspected agents/simplifier.md and executed Python assertions for the accepted V1/F1 translation-check example, permission for that failure to remain, and prohibitions on fixing rejected findings, changing tests to pass, or introducing failures.

Executed Python assertions on Maestro guidance and inspected both entry-tool messages. npm run check asserts both successful verification and all-rejected finding results direct maestro_run_simplifier next without another approval or verifier pass.
Inspected final-summary guidance and executed Python assertions requiring the saved S.json summary and notes as the simplifier report, explicitly excluding attribution to independent verifier checks.

npm run check: during the active scripted simplifier delegation, run-simplifier.integration.test.ts observes saved simplifier-running and the real Pi setStatus call with the broom icon and Simplifier running.

npm run check: extensions/maestro.integration.test.ts activates outside a Git repository, checks the UI-only default simplifier notice and custom thinking override, and preserves session history without model requests or Git skip predictions.

npm run check: extensions/maestro.integration.test.ts separately activates outside Git with an unavailable simplifier model and with only builder/verifier agents available; activation stays disabled and identifies each missing dependency.
npm run check: every Git skip scenario asserts no simplifier delegation request and no simplifier handoff.

notes: Final npm run check passed all 262 tests and coverage thresholds. npm run lint and git diff --check also passed.
Delegation scenarios use scripted responses with real Pi tool registration and filesystem operations. No real model refactoring or independent verification of refactored code is claimed.

Git discovery scope is defined in the bundled simplifier guidance: all current staged, unstaged, and untracked code changes, including pre-existing changes and necessary caller updates. No spec-specific starting commit or builder file list was added.
